hints: Both clamps are ifs that look at which way the arm is going and where it already is.
The top one is if (armPower > 0 && ticks >= 1100) { armPower = 0; ... } and the bottom one is an else if using < 0 and <= 50.

telemetry.addLine("arm at limit"); goes inside the top clamp, so it shows on every pass the arm is held there, and the telemetry.update() at the bottom sends it. The claw is if (gamepad1.a) { clawServo.setPosition(1.0); } else if (gamepad1.b) { clawServo.setPosition(0.0); }
